svg.title: Transcript lanes exceed the reconstructed evidence room
svg.desc: Extend transcript lanes past the room's edges while keeping the approximate count in lettering. The visible wall is a sample of scale, not the complete corpus. Use the on-premises evidence review room as a quiet setting layer; its empty areas carry no additional events or evidence.
